nina: T-10m final preflight. brief GO/NO-GO please. Plan: silent launch slice 4% ap-south, model=v3.3.0, quiet-window T+3m for 40m. runbook link pinned.

omar: staging smoke OK. tokenization diff minor, eval pass.

pat: infra warmed, prefetch 3M tokens. bumped client timeout 6s->5s.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] canary start -> service=redwood-inference version=v3.3.0 target=4% region=ap-south-1

sasha: oncall seeded KV cache and watching memory/autoscale.

nina: rollback shorthand: auto if 5xx rate >2% sustained 180s; perf pause if p95 >450ms for 5m; immediate rollback on safety regression.

pat: add cost guard: if cost/unit >15% for 20m then pause and notify finance (no auto-rollback).

deploy-bot: canary reached 4% -> health summary: success=99.4% p95=148ms errors=0.6% cost_delta=+3.8%

sasha: tiny retry blip at +2m, resolved by autoscale. no user-facing errors.

nina: calling conditional GO to ramp to 25% after 20m if stable. final approver = nina or omar.

omar: conditional GO.

oncall-bot: [oncall-bot] status-check: no Sev1 open. current pager: sasha. if rollback -> alert #release-war-room and tag @nina.

nina: thanks team  reconvene T+20m here. keep replies short and only post breaches. :rocket:
